categories.main_business_segments: Sinon Corporation operates primarily in crop protection, supermarket retail, household supplies, and catering services. The crop protection segment includes pesticides, fertilizers, microbial pesticides and fertilizers, agricultural materials, technical grade pesticides, biological control materials, fine chemicals, and intermediate products. The supermarket and household supplies divisions focus on retail and distribution of fresh produce, eco-friendly household goods, and catering services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis, biological fermentation, and nano-enhanced processing techniques to develop low-toxicity, eco-friendly pesticide formulations and fertilizers. It integrates microbial and biological control products, controlled-release fertilizers, and organic fertilizers derived from recycled agricultural materials. Production involves self-synthesis of technical materials and OEM/ODM manufacturing with process optimization, automated production, and quality management systems certified to ISO standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sinon serves farmers and agricultural businesses domestically in Taiwan and internationally across Europe, Japan, the Americas (including Brazil), India, Southeast Asia, and Australia. Customers include multinational agrochemical companies, distributors, retailers, and end-users such as farmers. The supermarket division targets consumers emphasizing freshness, safety, and health, while household goods cater to eco-conscious consumers and chain catering businesses.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taichung and Changhua. It has expanded markets internationally including Europe, Japan, the United States, Brazil, India, Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand), Australia, and other emerging markets. It maintains overseas subsidiaries and strategic alliances to support local sales and registrations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sinon operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the agrochemical supply chain. It synthesizes technical grade pesticides and produces formulated products, while also engaging in OEM manufacturing and direct sales. The company sources raw materials globally and supplies finished products to distributors, retailers, and farmers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in nano-pesticides, microbial and biological control products, registration-exempt crop protection materials, and eco-friendly fertilizers aligned with circular economy principles. It focuses on developing low-toxicity, safe formulations and enhancing product efficacy with nano-technology. Strategic R&D also targets drone-compatible agrochemicals, slow-release fertilizers, and expanding registrations in high-end international markets.
categories.revenue_model: Sinon generates revenue through product sales of crop protection chemicals, fertilizers, microbial products, and household goods. It also earns income from OEM/ODM manufacturing services and retail sales via its supermarket and catering divisions. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but focuses on direct sales and distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sinon is a leading domestic player in Taiwan's crop protection market with over 20% market share in pesticides and 11% in fertilizers. It competes with multinational agrochemical companies and local manufacturers by leveraging its R&D capabilities, product registrations, and strategic alliances. The company positions itself as a trustworthy crop protection science company emphasizing innovation, safety, and sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sinon reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$18.9 billion with a net profit after tax of about NT$1.05 billion, maintaining stable profitability and earnings per share of NT$2.5. The company has a paid-in capital of about NT$4.2 billion and total assets exceeding NT$15 billion. It has shown steady growth with ongoing investments in R&D and sustainability initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sinon emphasizes integrity, equity, and sustainable growth, offering comprehensive crop protection and nutritional cultivation solutions that are safe, eco-friendly, and aligned with global sustainability trends. Its product differentiation lies in advanced nano-technology formulations, microbial and biological products, and circular economy-based fertilizers. The company also provides strong technical support, extensive product registrations, and collaborates closely with international partners to meet evolving market and regulatory demands.
